design: held-out: combinational core derived from kleine-riscv src/units/alu.v (local copy has no license file; derived RTL stays in git-ignored runs/)
origin_note: Approximate structural reading: ADD/SUB share one adder (a + (mod ? -b : b)), SRL/SRA share a native arithmetic right shifter with a fill bit, SLL separate, case select. The original merges SLT/SLTU into one 33-bit signed compare, which the frozen vocabulary does not express; the origin row is therefore the nearest configuration, not the golden. All 16 opcode values are defined, so the default is unreachable.
